what: On the panel covering the Hero, a number counts up by 3 every 10ms to 99. After a wait (.7s), the big title letters slide up and out one by one (.5s power1.in, .05 stagger) while the same letters rise in from below (.9s power3.out after .2s). At the same time the title is pushed up 30vh (2s power4.inOut), the small photo window in the center opens from inset(22vh 38vw) to the screen edges (1.8s expo.inOut) while the photo inside grows to 130% width (power2.inOut), and the whole panel lifts away from bottom to top (clip-path 1.8s expo.inOut). On phones the window opens from inset(30vh 25vw)

options.hold: When the character swap starts (sec), default .7
options.dur: Duration (s) for the window to open and the panel to lift, default 1.8
options.lift: With on, the panel lifts upward and hides when done (default on) · with off, only the window opens and the panel stays
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Large title (text only) — the part splits it per letter into two lines: an exit set and a rising set
options.[data-fx-part=window]: (Optional) window that opens from the center — a screen-size panel with the photo inside
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: (optional) photo slot inside the window that grows in width from 30% to 130%
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: (optional, multiple) lower-line text · tags that switch on at .3s at the start
options.fx:enter · fx:done: Events fired from the element 1s after the panel starts to lift (when the next scene comes in) and when it has fully lifted
